scripts.build: npm run bump-build && turbo run build
scripts.bump-build:
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const appJsonPath=path.join(process.cwd(),'apps','mobile','app.json');const app=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(appJsonPath,'utf8'));const expo=app.expo||{};expo.ios=expo.ios||{};expo.android=expo.android||{};const nextIos=String((parseInt(expo.ios.buildNumber||'0',10)||0)+1);expo.ios.buildNumber=nextIos;expo.android.versionCode=(Number(expo.android.versionCode)||0)+1;app.expo=expo;fs.writeFileSync(appJsonPath,JSON.stringify(app,null,2)+'
');const version=expo.version||'unknown';const build=nextIos+'/'+String(expo.android.versionCode);const updateReadme=(p)=>{let t=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');const block=`## Build Info

- Version: ${version}
- Build: ${build}
`;if(t.includes('## Build Info')){t=t.replace(/## Build Info[\s\S]*?(?=
## |
# |$)/,block.trimEnd()+'
');}else{t=block+'
'+t;}fs.writeFileSync(p,t);};updateReadme(path.join(process.cwd(),'apps','mobile','README.md'));updateReadme(path.join(process.cwd(),'apps','web','README.md'));console.log('Build info updated:',{version,build});"
